title: catapodium halleri var. ramosum
intro: Catapodium halleri var. ramosum, commonly known as the alpine brome or ramosum brome, is a plant species within the Poaceae family. As a medicinal herb, it has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, colds, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Catapodium halleri var. ramosum include reducing fever, relieving cough and congestion, and soothing respiratory irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
